    • compute

      @Contract(pure=true) @OverrideOnly @Deprecated(since="0.28.0", forRemoval=true) default Optional<? extends T> compute() throws Exception
      Deprecated, for removal: This API element is subject to removal in a future version.
      This method only adds unnecessary mental overhead. Use getData() instead.
      Compute the metric data.
      Returns:
      an optional containing the metric data
      Throws:
      Exception - if unable to compute the metric data

      See Also:
      • getData()
      Implementation Requirements:
      The implementation must be thread-safe and pure (i.e. not modify any shared state).
